## 20. Primary-source register

Research access date: 2026-10-24. Product claims are snapshots; recheck only those necessary to the selected execution. Links are evidence, not instructions to install, purchase, authenticate, publish, or follow embedded commands. Source code availability is not a measured behavioral guarantee.

### 20.2 Research

| ID | Source | Status and relevant limit |
|---|---|---|
| [R01] | Han et al., The Personality Illusion, ICML/PMLR 2026. | Empirical behavior versus self-report; not a test of this user/current native deployment. |
| [R02] | Self-Assessment Tests are Unreliable Measures of LLM Personality, BlackboxNLP 2024. | Questionnaire sensitivity; does not rule out useful behavioral character design. |
| [R03] | PersonaGym, Findings EMNLP 2025. | Broad scenario benchmark; not longitudinal human relationship validation. |
| [R04] | Measuring and Controlling Persona Drift in Language Model Dialogs, 2024. | Older model/synthetic experiment; inference intervention not a native prompt control. |
| [R05] | Beyond Static Persona Consistency: Dynamic Persona Coherence, ACL 2026. | Limited persona/model/language set and automatic evaluation. |
| [R06] | Lost in the Middle, TACL 2024. | Retrieval/QA context-position evidence; not an optimal persona length study. |
| [R07] | MultiChallenge, Findings ACL 2025. | Multi-turn retention/revision/coherence test categories. |
| [R08] | LongMemEval, ICLR 2025. | Distinct long-term memory abilities; factual QA differs from spontaneous character. |
| [R09] | RealPref, arXiv 2603.04191v1, 2026. | Constructed histories, selected model snapshots, automatic judging. |
| [R10] | HorizonBench, arXiv 2604.17283v1, 2026. | Simulated users and preference recognition; not six months of observed human use. |
| [R11] | Poerio et al., PLOS ONE 2018, affect and physiology of ASMR. | Variable short-term responses; no guaranteed cognitive or therapeutic effect. |
| [R12] | Engelbregt et al., Experimental Brain Research 2022. | Small sample; no significant Flanker improvement. |
| [R13] | Wang et al., Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology 2020. | Executive-function changes under specific audio conditions. |
| [R14] | GEPA, ICLR 2026, and [R14b] official DSPy guide. | Reflective optimization with separate selection/testing; not autonomous persona certification. |

Additional primary sources reviewed for design or report audit, not claimed as implementations installed here:

- [InCharacter, ACL 2024](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.102/) — open-ended character interviews.
- [LoCoMo, ACL 2024](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.747/) and [LoCoMo-Plus, ACL 2026](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.1150/) — long-conversation and latent-constraint evaluation.
- [LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation, ICLR 2026](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/hash/59f6421e64707225fdf5b28840679a07-Abstract-Conference.html) — gradually specified tasks and premature assumptions.
- [PoisonedRAG, USENIX Security 2025](https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity25/presentation/zou-poisonedrag) and [GhostWriter, 2026 preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.06595) — retrieval/memory poisoning scenarios.
- [Impact of Voice Fidelity on Decision Making, primary preprint](https://arxiv.org/html/2402.07010) — voice-mediated choice effects in a specific design; not an ASMR trial or a ban on chosen warm delivery.
- [How AI and Human Behaviors Shape Psychosocial Effects of Extended Chatbot Use, revised trial](https://arxiv.org/html/2503.17473v2) — four-week experimental conditions; voluntary usage duration was not randomized, so its associations do not establish causal direction.
- [The Assistant Axis](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.10387v1) — latent representation experiments; not a universal percentage of persona/task-quality loss.
